title: Simultaneous Inference Bands for Autocorrelations
abstract: arXiv:2503.18560v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sample autocorrelograms typically come with significance (non-rejection) bands for the null hypothesis of no temporal correlation. These bands have three shortcomings. First, they build on pointwise intervals and suffer from joint undercoverage (overrejection) under the null hypothesis. Second, in cases where this null is clearly violated one would rather prefer to see confidence bands to quantify estimation uncertainty. Third, they are invalid under conditional heteroskedasticity. We propose both simultaneous significance and confidence bands for time series and series of regression residuals. Our simultaneous inference bands are as easy to construct as their pointwise counterparts and at the same time provide an intuitive and visual quantification of sampling uncertainty as well as valid statistical inference. translated_abstract: arXiv:2503.18560v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：样本自相关图通常伴随着针对无时间相关性零假设的显著性（非拒绝）带。这些带存在三个缺点。首先，它们基于逐点区间构建，在零假设下存在联合覆盖不足（过度拒绝）的问题。其次，在零假设明显被违反的情况下，人们更倾向于看到置信带以量化估计不确定性。第三，它们在条件异方差下无效。我们提出了针对时间序列和回归残差序列的联合显著性和置信带。我们的联合推断带在构建上与其逐点对应物一样简单，同时提供了对抽样不确定性的直观视觉量化以及有效的统计推断。对于动态回归的残差，我们展示了如何将观测时间序列和静态回归情形下的推断带进行扩展。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新型自相关联合推断带，解决了传统逐点带在零假设下的联合覆盖不足、置信区间缺失及条件异方差下的无效性问题，构建简单且提供有效的统计推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes novel simultaneous inference bands for autocorrelations, addressing joint undercoverage, lack of confidence bands, and invalidity under conditional heteroskedasticity, while remaining as easy to construct as pointwise counterparts.
